8405ef0444a976b88735bbde0a30f2c3.overview: A Jewish boy separated from his family in the early days of WWII poses as a German orphan and is taken into the heart of the Nazi world as a 'war hero' and eventually becomes a Hitler Youth.

840acd793f77c351b0f111bff6663adc.overview: Wally, a struggling playwright and actor, reluctantly agrees to catch up with his old friend Andre, a theater director who disappeared several years prior in order to travel the world. Meeting at a posh Manhattan restaurant, the two share life stories, anecdotes and philosophical musings over the course of an evening meal.

840cb01c65ec81159a1a7a9d01b59eeb.overview: A family living on a farm finds mysterious crop circles in their fields which suggests something more frightening to come.
840cb01c65ec81159a1a7a9d01b59eeb.tagline: It's not like they didn't warn us.

841dca108ef7eac20c53e9522d8b6107.overview: Two lonely people in the big city meet and enjoy the thrills of an amusement park, only to lose each other in the crowd after spending a great day together. Will they ever see each other again?
841dca108ef7eac20c53e9522d8b6107.tagline: With all the glamor and glitter of Coney Island that millions everywhere are always eager to see

84224758ffec440c31c07dbfea5c4ff2.overview: During America’s Civil War, Union spies steal engineer Johnnie Gray's beloved locomotive, 'The General'—with Johnnie's lady love aboard an attached boxcar—and he single-handedly must do all in his power to both get The General back and to rescue Annabelle.
84224758ffec440c31c07dbfea5c4ff2.tagline: Buster drives "The General" to trainload of laughter.

8434821bac3dbb528e334eede2100a9f.overview: After leaving a wealthy Belgian family to become a nun, Sister Luke struggles with her devotion to her vows during crisis, disappointment, and World War II.
8434821bac3dbb528e334eede2100a9f.tagline: From the very beginning, she was not like the others...

84af5c7d040c04158c111d52ef180b2e.overview: Urban horticulturalist Brontë Mitchell has her eye on a gorgeous apartment, but the building's board will rent it only to a married couple. Georges Fauré, a waiter from France whose visa is expiring, needs to marry an American woman to stay in the country. Their marriage of convenience turns into a burden when they must live together to allay the suspicions of the immigration service, as the polar opposites grate on each other's nerves.
84af5c7d040c04158c111d52ef180b2e.tagline: The story of two people who got married, met and then fell in love.

84d1763bbbdfb3dfb5abd38e1d57c625.overview: In the shadow of an enormous hydraulic dam, the lives of the residents of a small French town are changed to their core when hundreds of previously dead relatives all return home on the same day.

84db53e92c1f72aa9b26b5b9221e832d.overview: Three cowboys, mistaken for members of an outlaw gang, are relentlessly pursued by a posse.
84db53e92c1f72aa9b26b5b9221e832d.tagline: Ride with the Easy Rider into an action whirlwind.

84deeca2958ad542e1524b6acedd1bb5.overview: Island of Java, 1942, during World War II. British Major Jack Celliers arrives at a Japanese prison camp, run by the strict Captain Yonoi. Colonel John Lawrence, who has a profound knowledge of Japanese culture, and Sergeant Hara, brutal and simpleton, will witness the struggle of wills between two men from very different backgrounds who are tragically destined to clash.
84deeca2958ad542e1524b6acedd1bb5.tagline: Java, 1942 — A clash of cultures, a test of the human spirit.

84f4ac0390d221dcfd5352fb34ca0c64.overview: Everyone has their own Chimera, something they try to achieve but never manage to find. For Arthur, the Chimera looks like the woman he lost, Beniamina. In an adventurous journey between the living and the dead, between forests and cities, between celebrations and solitudes, the intertwined destinies of these characters unfold, all in search of the Chimera.
